name: Droitwich Spa Foodbank
short_description: Trussell Trust foodbank in Droitwich Spa
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at Droitwich Community Church. Open Tue 10am-2pm and Fri 9am-12pm. Referral required via local agencies.
